subject: math
question:
求解 $n$ 元线性方程组 $AX = b$ ，其中

$$
\boldsymbol {A} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c c c c} 2 a & 1 & & & & \\ a ^ {2} & 2 a & 1 & & & \\ & a ^ {2} & 2 a & 1 & & \\ & & \ddots & \ddots & \ddots & \\ & & & a ^ {2} & 2 a & 1 \\ & & & & a ^ {2} & 2 a \end{array} \right), \quad \boldsymbol {X} = \left( \begin{array}{c} x _ {1} \\ x _ {2} \\ \vdots \\ x _ {n} \end{array} \right), \quad \boldsymbol {b} = \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 0 \\ \vdots \\ 0 \end{array} \right).
$$

steps.text:
分析 方程组的系数矩阵是三对角线形，该矩阵的行列式容易计算，所以用克莱姆法则较好. 解 记 $D_{n} = |A|$ ，将行列式按第一行展开，有

$$
\begin{array}{r l} D _ {n} & = 2 a \left| \begin{array}{c c c c c c} 2 a & 1 & & & & \\ a ^ {2} & 2 a & 1 & & & \\ & a ^ {2} & 2 a & 1 & & \\ & & \ddots & \ddots & \ddots & \\ & & & a ^ {2} & 2 a & 1 \\ & & & & a ^ {2} & 2 a \end{array} \right| _ {n - 1} + a ^ {2} (- 1) ^ {2 + 1} \left| \begin{array}{c c c c c c} 1 & 0 & & & & \\ a ^ {2} & 2 a & 1 & & & \\ & a ^ {2} & 2 a & 1 & & \\ & & \ddots & \ddots & \ddots & \\ & & & a ^ {2} & 2 a & 1 \\ & & & & a ^ {2} & 2 a \end{array} \right| _ {n - 1} \\ & = 2 a D _ {n - 1} - a ^ {2} D _ {n - 2}. \end{array}
$$

变形再做递推，有

$$
\begin{array}{r l} D _ {n} - a D _ {n - 1} & = a (D _ {n - 1} - a D _ {n - 2}) = \dots = a ^ {n - 2} (D _ {2} - a D _ {1}) = a ^ {n} \quad (D _ {1} = 2 a, D _ {2} = 3 a ^ {2}). \\ D _ {n} & = a D _ {n - 1} + a ^ {n} = a ^ {2} (D _ {n - 2} + a ^ {n - 1}) + a ^ {n} = a ^ {2} D _ {n - 2} + 2 a ^ {n} \\ & = \dots = a ^ {n - 1} D _ {1} + (n - 1) a ^ {n} = (n + 1) a ^ {n}. \end{array}
$$

（1）当 $a \neq 0$ 时， $D_n \neq 0$ ，方程组有唯一解。记 $A_i (i = 1,2,\dots,n)$ 表示用 $b$ 去替换 $A$ 中的第 $i$ 列得到的矩阵。对行列式 $|A_i|$ 按第 $i$ 列展开可得到

$$
\begin{array}{l} \mid A _ {1} \mid = (- 1) ^ {2} D _ {n - 1} = n a ^ {n - 1}, \quad \mid A _ {2} \mid = (- 1) ^ {3} a ^ {2} D _ {n - 2} = - (n - 1) a ^ {n}, \quad \dots \\ \mid A _ {i} \mid = (- 1) ^ {i + 1} (a ^ {2}) ^ {i - 1} D _ {n - i} = (- 1) ^ {i + 1} (n - i + 1) a ^ {n + i - 2} \quad (i = 1, 2, \dots , n). \end{array}
$$

由克

分析 方程组的系数矩阵是三对角线形，该矩阵的行列式容易计算，所以用克莱姆法则较好. 解 记 $D_{n} = |A|$ ，将行列式按第一行展开，有

$$
\begin{array}{r l} D _ {n} & = 2 a \left| \begin{array}{c c c c c c} 2 a & 1 & & & & \\ a ^ {2} & 2 a & 1 & & & \\ & a ^ {2} & 2 a & 1 & & \\ & & \ddots & \ddots & \ddots & \\ & & & a ^ {2} & 2 a & 1 \\ & & & & a ^ {2} & 2 a \end{array} \right| _ {n - 1} + a ^ {2} (- 1) ^ {2 + 1} \left| \begin{array}{c c c c c c} 1 & 0 & & & & \\ a ^ {2} & 2 a & 1 & & & \\ & a ^ {2} & 2 a & 1 & & \\ & & \ddots & \ddots & \ddots & \\ & & & a ^ {2} & 2 a & 1 \\ & & & & a ^ {2} & 2 a \end{array} \right| _ {n - 1} \\ & = 2 a D _ {n - 1} - a ^ {2} D _ {n - 2}. \end{array}
$$

变形再做递推，有

$$
\begin{array}{r l} D _ {n} - a D _ {n - 1} & = a (D _ {n - 1} - a D _ {n - 2}) = \dots = a ^ {n - 2} (D _ {2} - a D _ {1}) = a ^ {n} \quad (D _ {1} = 2 a, D _ {2} = 3 a ^ {2}). \\ D _ {n} & = a D _ {n - 1} + a ^ {n} = a ^ {2} (D _ {n - 2} + a ^ {n - 1}) + a ^ {n} = a ^ {2} D _ {n - 2} + 2 a ^ {n} \\ & = \dots = a ^ {n - 1} D _ {1} + (n - 1) a ^ {n} = (n + 1) a ^ {n}. \end{array}
$$

（1）当 $a \neq 0$ 时， $D_n \neq 0$ ，方程组有唯一解。记 $A_i (i = 1,2,\dots,n)$ 表示用 $b$ 去替换 $A$ 中的第 $i$ 列得到的矩阵。对行列式 $|A_i|$ 按第 $i$ 列展开可得到

$$
\begin{array}{l} \mid A _ {1} \mid = (- 1) ^ {2} D _ {n - 1} = n a ^ {n - 1}, \quad \mid A _ {2} \mid = (- 1) ^ {3} a ^ {2} D _ {n - 2} = - (n - 1) a ^ {n}, \quad \dots \\ \mid A _ {i} \mid = (- 1) ^ {i + 1} (a ^ {2}) ^ {i - 1} D _ {n - i} = (- 1) ^ {i + 1} (n - i + 1) a ^ {n + i - 2} \quad (i = 1, 2, \dots , n). \end{array}
$$

由克莱姆法则得方程组的解为

$$
x _ {i} = \frac {\left| A _ {i} \right|}{\left| A \right|} = \frac {(- 1) ^ {i + 1} (n - i + 1) a ^ {n + i - 2}}{(n + 1) a ^ {n}} = (- 1) ^ {i + 1} \left(1 - \frac {i}{n + 1}\right) a ^ {i - 2} \quad (i = 1, 2, \dots , n).
$$

(2) 当 a=0 时，方程组为

$$
\cdot \left( \begin{array}{c c c c c} 0 & 1 & & & \\ & 0 & 1 & & \\ & & 0 & \ddots & \\ & & & \ddots & 1 \\ & & & & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} x _ {1} \\ x _ {2} \\ \vdots \\ x _ {n} \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 0 \\ \vdots \\ 0 \end{array} \right).
$$

由于 $\operatorname{rank}(A) = \operatorname{rank}(\overline{A}) = n - 1$ ，因此方程组有无穷多解.

对应齐次方程组的基础解系为 $\boldsymbol{\xi}=(1,0,0,\cdots,0)^{\mathrm{T}}$ ，非齐次方程组的一个特解为 $\boldsymbol{\eta}=(0,1,0,\cdots,0)^{\mathrm{T}}$ .

方程组 AX = b 的通解为

$X=(0,1,0,\cdots,0)^{\mathrm{T}}+k(1,0,0,\cdots,0)^{\mathrm{T}}$ (k为任意常数).

评注（1）三对角线形行列式的计算通常有两种方法：①递推法；②归纳法证明.
(2) 该题也可以用高斯消元法求解，但要困难些.
